_note: Threats log actor columns, in the analysts' own wording (revised 2026-11-04). Add new values here; lib/config/threatActors.js reads this file. The model may propose a type that is not listed — the review sheet flags it — and an approved one is added here.
_note_combined: Types that may be joined with "; " (at most two), e.g. "Nation-state; Cybercriminal". Only these types name groups in the Threat Actor column.
_note_actor_values: Threat Actor value for each type when there is nothing more specific. Attacker types list named groups (up to max_named_actors, more → "Multiple"), otherwise "Unattributed" — no descriptions. AI system takes a short description of the model(s); Vendor research/evaluation may take a description of the AI tool or model studied.
